content.text: MC cause of large bowel obstruction in adults
•diet (low fiber, high in red or processed meat, animal fat)
: physical activity, regular use of ASA, NSAIDs
– almost all will develop colon cancer by age 45yrs; prophylactic colectomy best for survival
: autosomal dominant; d/t loss of function in DNA mismatch repair genes (
); 40% risk of colon cancer – mean age late 40s
(lips, oral mucosa, hands) – risk of breast/pancreatic cancer
(fatigue, weakness), rectal bleeding, abdominal pain, change in bowel habits
, (CRC is MC cause of occult GI bleeding in adults)
•fecal occult blood test annually starting at 50yrs
•flexible sigmoidoscopy q5yrs + fecal occult blood testing q3yrs
